stem.en: Meera asks a chatbot for the score of a cricket match played this morning. The model's training ended long before the match. Is each statement true or false?

text.en: With no search tool, the model can still write a smooth report of the match.
If the app adds a page from a search, the model reads it as text in its context window.
A sure tone in the report shows that the score has support.
Using search makes certain that the report is true.
If Meera corrects the score in the chat, the model's settings change.

explanation.en: The model always has a next token, so it can write a report with nothing true behind it. A search result is only more text, so a wrong page gives wrong text, and tone is not support. Her correction is text in this chat too, because settings change only in training.

hints.en: Keep the model and the app apart in your mind.
